task_definitions.title: Document Notion Database Schema Requirements
task_definitions.description: Create comprehensive documentation of the required Notion database schema, including all property types (Task title, Assigned To people, Status select, Notes rich_text, ID number), property names, and configuration requirements.
acceptance_criteria: All required properties documented with types

task_definitions.title: Implement Task Query/Retrieval Functionality
task_definitions.description: Add function to retrieve tasks from Notion database with filtering capabilities. Function should support querying by status, assignee, and task ID. Return structured task data.
acceptance_criteria: Support retrieving single task by ID

task_definitions.title: Implement Task Deletion Functionality
task_definitions.description: Add function to delete (archive) tasks from Notion database by page ID. Notion API archives pages rather than permanently deleting them.

task_definitions.title: Enhance Assignee Handling
task_definitions.description: Modify createTask() function to properly handle assignee parameter. Currently the 'Assigned To' field is hardcoded to an empty array. Implement logic to accept Notion user IDs and populate the people property correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Function properly formats people property for Notion API

task_definitions.title: Add Task Search and Filtering
task_definitions.description: Implement advanced search functionality to filter tasks by multiple criteria including status, date ranges, assignee, and text search in title/notes. Leverage Notion API filtering capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Support text search in title and notes

task_definitions.title: Implement Bulk Task Operations
task_definitions.description: Add functionality to perform bulk operations on multiple tasks simultaneously, including bulk create, bulk update status, and bulk archive operations.
acceptance_criteria: Proper error handling for partial failures

task_definitions.title: Create Unit Tests for API Functions
task_definitions.description: Implement comprehensive unit tests for all Notion API interaction functions using a testing framework (Jest or Mocha). Mock Notion API calls to test logic without requiring live API access.

task_definitions.title: Refactor Code into Modular Structure
task_definitions.description: Refactor the single index.js file into a modular structure with separate files for API client configuration, task operations, utility functions, and example usage. Improve code organization and maintainability.
acceptance_criteria: Code split into logical modules (client.js, tasks.js, utils.js, examples.js)
No breaking changes to existing functionality
Updated package.json entry point if needed

task_definitions.title: Create CLI Interface
task_definitions.description: Develop a command-line interface using a library like commander.js to enable task management operations from the terminal. Support commands for create, update, list, search, and delete tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Commands implemented: create, update, list, search, delete
Executable via npm scripts or bin entry

task_definitions.title: Add Comprehensive Error Handling and Validation
task_definitions.description: Enhance error handling throughout the application. Add input validation, custom error classes, retry logic for API failures, and detailed error messages.
acceptance_criteria: Input validation for all public functions
Retry logic for transient API failures

task_definitions.title: Create Comprehensive Documentation
task_definitions.description: Write complete project documentation including README with setup instructions, API reference, usage examples, troubleshooting guide, and contribution guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Updated README.md with full project description

task_definitions.title: Add Integration Tests
task_definitions.description: Create integration tests that verify end-to-end functionality with a test Notion database. Tests should cover complete workflows including creating, updating, querying, and deleting tasks.
